notes.title: Small Patch Fix 3
notes.content:
Hello.

We have just released a small update to fix a few problems, which are detailed bellow.

1. Fixed an issue where certain cosmetics weren't unlocking and saving at the end of levels. This was also causing an issue where certain achievements were skipped.

2. Fixed an issue where ghosts weren't showing the correct cosmetics.

3. Fixed an image on the level select menu.

We apologize for such a late update and hope you continue to enjoy RUSHAWAY.

notes.title: New Update - Portuguese Localization and More
notes.content:
Hi there,
On this second update, we are bringing some new things to RUSHAWAY.

 - Portuguese Localization - 

Our first big change in this update is a full localization of the game to Portuguese(Portugal). This required a complete update to all game texts. However, now the game is prepared to receive other possible future localizations.

 - Cosmetic Updates - 

The second big change from this update is new cosmetic options. Not only did we increase the number of unlockable cosmetics, but we also added a new type of leg cosmetics. These can be equipped per leg, alongside the previously supported body and head types.

 - Other Small Changes - 

The following list is composed of a series of small changes to various different aspects of the game.


UI elements updates. A visual component was added to the levels to better translate to the player his current position on world progression. Showcase the previous best time achieved on Rush Mode, during subsequent runs through the mode.

Added a few limited animations to the "Resolution" cutscene.

Adjusted Speck's position relative to the floor.

Updated the color scheme of some elements from Sky Garden and Volcano Heights Worlds.

Lowered the Medal requirement necessary to unlock the Final Tower.

 - Demo Update - 

Finally, for those who still haven't had the chance to try out the game, we have also updated the demo with a newer version, on par with the current release of the game.

notes.title: RUSHAWAY another small update
notes.content:
Hey all,

Today we come to you with a small update, we've just added support for ultrawide screens.

It's a small thing but we hope it helps some players immerse themselves more in the game.

We continues to enjoy RUSHAWAY as we, also, continue to improve it little by little. 

And as we find ourselves at the tale end of the summer sale, there is still some time to get those sweat deals on games one wants.

Good Purchases and Happy Gaming.

notes.title: First Update - Cosmetics
notes.content:
Hi there!

Throughout these past few months, while we've been silent, work on RUSHAWAY as been progressing. We've been working on fixes and improvements to known issues, some of which we have been releasing since February. Alongside these, we've also been working on new stuff.

Today, we release our first update with a new addition, Cosmetics. 

In the past, we received feedback from players asking for a way to customize Speck. And so, we created these new unlockables, which Speck can wear.

As you unlock them, you will be able to pick from a small variety of head and body pieces, that can be combined to give Speck your preferred flare, and even spice up your ghosts.

Expect more updates, as we continue to improve RUSHAWAY.

Until then, happy gaming!

notes.title: Small Patch Fix
notes.content:
We've identified, and patched, three problems with the previous build.


 Leaderboards for trial levels are no longer displaying incorrectly. They're also titled numerically from now on.
 Vsync option, in the Options screen, is now saving correctly.
 Volume options no longer reset when returning to the Options screen.

We are sorry for any inconvenience these issues might have caused.

notes.title: RUSHAWAY's release date is here!
notes.content:
We are overjoyed to see people playing and exploring RUSHAWAY these past few days.

Like we said in the past, this game has been a passion project for a few years now, and, we currently believe, to finally be reaching something close to a complete game.

It is with excitement that we announce that RUSHAWAY will release on:
 
February 22, 2023

And as we prepare for the game's full release, we also plan on supporting it throughout the near future, as we try to make RUSHAWAY the best possible RUSHAWAY we can make.

Thanks again for all the support and happy gaming!
